```{r}

# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(readr)
library(rstatix)
library(dplyr)
library(multcompView)
```

Figure 4. Differential inhibition of Zymoseptoria tritici strains by wheat-associated bacteria.

```{r}

# 1. Load data
df <- read_csv("wheat_bacteria_vs_Zt_IPO323.csv")  # Replace with your actual file path

df <- df %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("IPO323", "AvrStb6")))


# 2.Perform ANOVA separately for each bacterial genus
anova_results <- df %>%
  group_by(bacteria_genus) %>%
  anova_test(inhibition_length ~ treatment)

# Print ANOVA results
print(anova_results)

# Perform Tukey's post hoc test for each bacterial genus
tukey_results <- df %>%
  group_by(bacteria_genus) %>%
  tukey_hsd(inhibition_length ~ treatment)

# Print Tukey test results
print(tukey_results)


# 3. Reorganise and rename bacterial and fungal strains

df$bacteria_genus <- factor(
  df$bacteria_genus,
  levels = c(
    "Pseudomonas",
    "Pantoea",
    "Enterobacter",
    "Curtobacterium",
    "Flavobacterium",
    "Rahnella"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "Pseudomonas",
    "Pantoea",
    "Enterobacter",
    "Curtobacterium",
    "Flavobacterium",
    "Rahnella"
  )
)

df$treatment <- factor(
  df$treatment,
  levels = c(
    "IPO323",
    "AvrStb6"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "IPO323",
    "IPO323 ∆AvrStb6"
  )
)


# 4. Create box plot

ggboxplot(df, x = "bacteria_genus", y = "inhibition_length",
          fill = "treatment",
          color = "treatment",
          add = "jitter",
          add.params = list(size = 2, alpha = 0.9),
          width = 0.7,
          alpha = 0.4,                    # transparency for boxes
          outlier.shape = NA) +
  labs(title = "Inhibition by bacteria genus",
       x = "Bacteria genus",
       y = "Inhibition length (mm)",
       color = "Zymoseptoria tritici isolate",
       fill = "Zymoseptoria tritici isolate") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Avenir Next Medium"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic")
  )


### Save the plot
ggsave("wheat_bacteria_vs_Zt_IPO323.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 800)


```

Supplementary Figure 4. Strain-level variation in bacterial inhibition of Zymoseptoria tritici. 

```{r}


# Plot per strain (lab_ID) within each genus

ggboxplot(df, x = "treatment", y = "inhibition_length",
          fill = "treatment",
          color = "treatment",
          add = "jitter",
          add.params = list(size = 2, alpha = 0.9),
          width = 0.6,
          alpha = 0.4,
          outlier.shape = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ bacteria_genus + strain_ID, ncol = 6)+
  labs(title = "Inhibition by individual bacterial strains",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Inhibition length (mm)",
       color = "Zymoseptoria tritici isolate",
       fill = "Zymoseptoria tritici isolate") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Avenir Next Medium"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "italic"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

### Save the plot
ggsave("Sup_Fig_4_wheat_bacteria_strains_vs_Zt_IPO323.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 800)


```
